source_name: Ministrstvo za digitalno preobrazbo (MDP) - razpisi and pozivi on GOV.SI
why_relevant: The ministry responsible for the RRF digitalisation components (e.g. modernisation of the digital environment of public administration, the component code seen on a procurement notice). Its calls and procurements are the largest single EU-financed digital-infrastructure spend channel in SI, and public-administration payment/e-identity/e-services work overlaps directly with the payments domain.

source_name: Ministrstvo za gospodarstvo, turizem in šport (MGTS) - DIPI / JR-DIGIT-NOO documentation
source_subtype: line ministry call + ex-post monitoring reports
why_relevant: MGTS runs the JR-DIGIT-NOO family of RRF digitalisation calls for enterprises and publishes not only the calls but ex-post monitoring reports on beneficiaries (a 'poročilo o opravljenih terenskih ogledih projektov' was observed on its DIPI/Razpisi path). Ex-post beneficiary reporting is rare and valuable: it names who actually received the money and what they built.

source_name: World Bank Finances One - Procurement Notices dataset and record pages
why_relevant: The World Bank publishes its procurement notices as a queryable dataset (also mirrored in the World Bank Data Catalog), covering general procurement notices, specific notices, consultant-selection notices and contract awards. Slovenia engages the World Bank mainly through Reimbursable Advisory Services rather than lending, so hits will be sparse - but where an RAS engagement touches the financial sector, this is the disclosure channel, and it is fully machine-readable.

source_name: European Commission Representation in Slovenia - Razpisi za financiranje v EU
why_relevant: A Slovenian-language aggregation layer maintained by the Commission's national representation, pointing to EU-level funding calls (including centrally managed programmes such as Digital Europe) as they are relevant to Slovenian applicants. Useful as a cross-check that no EU-financed call channel touching SI financial services has been missed, and as a source of the canonical Slovenian terminology for EU funding instruments.

source_name: ARIS (Javna agencija za znanstvenoraziskovalno in inovacijsko dejavnost RS) - NOO razpisi in pozivi
why_relevant: A dedicated RRF-financed call stream run by the research agency. Relevant to this cell as an example of the fragmented SI pattern - each agency maintains its own NOO razpisi subsite rather than a single national NOO tender register - and occasionally funds fintech/payments-adjacent applied research with financial-institution partners.

source_name: Commercial IFI-tender aggregators (TendersOnTime, TendersInfo, GlobalTenders) - EBRD/EIB/World Bank feeds
why_relevant: Third-party aggregators re-publish IFI notices with their own indexing and often retain notices after the issuing body removes them, which makes them useful for historical reconstruction and for cross-checking that an IFI channel was not missed. They are not authoritative and are paywalled beyond teaser level, so they should be used as a discovery/QA aid only, never as a primary record.

source_name: Razpis.eu and ANAplus - Slovenian commercial call-monitoring newsletters
why_relevant: Slovenian consultancy-run trackers that summarise open javni razpisi in plain language, often faster and more searchable than the official portals, and they explicitly tag the funding source (NOO, EKP, ESRR). Useful as a recall net for calls that the official crawls miss and as a source of sector jargon. Secondary and commercially motivated, so every item must be resolved back to Uradni list or the issuing body.

source_name: Javnirazpisi.com (Tender Service Group) - Slovenian & European tender aggregator
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator operating in SI since 2005 (part of Tender Service Group). Aggregates public tenders and contracts from SI and Europe with personalised search profiles, sector/branch taxonomies and email/mobile alerts. Its branch taxonomy is also a POINTER to which SI buyers publish where, and it retains notices in a searchable archive beyond the official portal's active window.

source_name: EUJN Javni razpisi (EUJN Razpisi d.o.o.)
why_relevant: SI commercial alert service notifying subscribers of newly published public tenders matched to their activity. Maintains categorised listings ('javna nabava') useful to see which SI contracting authorities in finance/IT publish recurring notices.

source_name: Forum Media - Portal Javna naročila / Javni razpisi
why_relevant: Publisher-run SI procurement portal (OPTIMUM package) offering free daily/weekly notification of first publications and amendments from the national portal (enarocanje/ejn.gov.si) and EU eTendering. Combines aggregation with editorial/legal commentary that flags procurement-law changes affecting bank IT buying.

source_name: Trite.si - Javna naročila (MORS/DRSI notification service)
why_relevant: Niche SI notification service focused on specific contracting authorities. Low direct banking relevance but demonstrates the buyer-scoped alert model and is a POINTER to how small SI resellers slice the national portal feed.

source_name: Opentender.eu - Slovenia portal (DIGIWHIST / Government Transparency Institute)
why_relevant: NGO/research aggregator that structures and normalises SI procurement data (buyers, suppliers, CPV, single-bidding and red-flag indicators) from the national portal and TED. Best-in-class for supplier-side analysis: identifies which vendors win SI financial-sector IT contracts, and retains historical notices independent of the official portal.

source_name: Opentender.eu Slovenia - buyer and supplier entity pages
why_relevant: Per-entity pages (authority/company) resolve SI buyers and winning suppliers to stable IDs with their full contract history - an actor-map generator for the SI procurement landscape, letting us snowball from one bank/PSP-adjacent contract to the whole vendor cluster.

source_name: TED - Tenders Electronic Daily (EU official archive, SI notices)
why_relevant: The authoritative EU-level archive of above-threshold SI contract notices and CONTRACT AWARD notices, with CPV, buyer, supplier and value fields. Free unauthenticated search API plus daily/monthly XML bulk packages; historical XML back to 1993. This is the backbone archive against which every commercial reseller in this cell is a repackaging.

source_name: EU Publications Office - public procurement notice detail pages (SI)
why_relevant: Per-notice permalink pages for SI procurements (observed for Ljubljana data-network maintenance, Celje transport, etc.) - stable, citable archive records with CPV codes, usable as evidence anchors for individual award findings.

source_name: Open Opportunities (openopps.com) - Slovenia eNarocanje source feed
why_relevant: Aggregator that ingests the SI national portal (e-narocanje) as a named source and republishes normalised records with alerting. Its per-source page is a POINTER documenting exactly which SI feed is being harvested and at what cadence.

source_name: Bidovate - Slovenia procurement aggregation
why_relevant: EU-focused aggregator with a dedicated Slovenia source page merging SI notices into one searchable interface; another reseller layer over the national portal/TED worth benchmarking for archive depth.

source_name: TendersInfo - Slovenia tenders and contract awards
why_relevant: Classic TendersInfo-type reseller (the archetype named in this cell). Claims daily aggregation from thousands of government sources plus a separate Slovenia contract-awards view and some private tenders. Value is breadth and the awards archive; quality/freshness needs verification.

source_name: GlobalTenders - Slovenia government tenders and contract awards
why_relevant: Reseller exposing SI contract awards with contractor names and bid amounts - occasionally surfaces award detail that is hard to reach in the SI portal UI. Treat as lead-generation, always re-verify against TED or the national portal.

source_name: Tender Impulse - Slovenia tenders
why_relevant: Reseller aggregating SI e-procurement portals and government sites, with date-sliced list pages that act as a crude daily archive; also offers bid consultancy, which signals which SI opportunity types attract foreign bidders.

source_name: BidDetail - Slovenia tenders
why_relevant: Another TendersInfo-class reseller listing SI eProcurement/eTender opportunities; useful only as a triangulation check that a notice exists and as a cross-source coverage benchmark.

source_name: TendersOnTime / TendersTech - Slovenia notices and contract awards
why_relevant: Reseller family exposing SI contract-award pages and individually addressable notice records (e.g. an 'Information systems' contract notice in Slovenia), giving another route to award detail when the national portal has purged the listing.

source_name: Mercell (incl. EU-Supply / Mercell Tender Service) - pan-European tender discovery
why_relevant: The largest European commercial aggregator and the closest analogue to the 'TenderNed-style' service named in this cell. Claims Europe-wide coverage of public and private tenders and awards, monitoring 2,500+ sources. SI coverage is asserted only implicitly (EU/Nordic/Baltic wording) and must be confirmed with the vendor.
